facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Music drifted across the farm. Other animals heard it too. A farm cat came purring softly. An old horse came for cake. Even dragonflies joined in. Pip's heart was full of joy. Wooly danced with Daisy. Everyone celebrated.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Soon other farm animals heard the gentle music and came to join the fun. The farm cat padded over and curled up by the table, purring softly. An old gray horse with kind eyes rested in the shade of the apple trees, swishing his tail to the beat. Even the dragonflies hovered in the warm afternoon air like tiny dancers. A pair of sparrows sang from a nearby fence post. Everyone — animal, bird, insect — moved together to the soft music, each in their own way. Pip danced with Wooly, then with Daisy, his hooves tapping happily. Everyone celebrated, and the farm felt alive with joy.
